blocks.text: New on Amazon in past month
An elevated dog bed provides your pet with a comfortable place to rest, making their every day happier.

The additional support leg design makes the outdoor dog bed's load-bearing capacity stronger and more stable. The maximum load-bearing capacity can reach 150 pounds, which is suitable for all kinds of large dogs.

The raised dog bed frame can lift your pet more than 7.5 inches off the ground, allowing air to flow freely on all sides and underneath to keep your pet cool. In addition, the cooling dog bed can reduce the pressure on your pet's joints, keeping your pet cool and staying away from hard surfaces.
The newly designed dog cot bed allows your dog to have a comfortable place to rest. An outdoor pet bed can be used indoors and outdoors. It can also be taken with you for travel, camping, etc.

Why choose us
 1. The dog elevated bed is easy to assemble, disassemble, and carry
 2. Sturdy metal frame, load-bearing up to 150 pounds
 3. Breathable Oxford cloth
 4. Lift pets 7.5 inches off the ground to keep pets clean and cool on rainy or hot days.
 5. Lightweight, easy to move and carry, can be used indoors and outdoors.

items: 【Raised Dog Bed】The dog elevated bed is designed to be off the ground, effectively promoting air circulation. It can keep your dog cool in summer and dry in winter, making it suitable for pets of all ages. In addition, the off-ground design makes it easier to clean the dog bed; simply rinse it with water.

【Durable and sturdy】In order to extend the service life of the indestructible dog bed, we have added an additional support leg in the middle of the dog outdoor bed frame to effectively prevent the bed frame from breaking. Compared to regular dog cooling bed, this dog elevated bed can support up to 150 pounds, providing a safe and comfortable resting place for dogs.

【Cooling Dog Bed with Ice Pack】In order to provide pets with a comfortable summer, we have equipped four self-absorbing ice packs. You can freeze the ice pack in the refrigerator for 4-8 hours after absorbing water, and then take it out and place it on the back of the dog cooling bed. With this outside dog bed, you no longer need to turn on the air conditioning for your pet separately in summer.

【Unique U-shaped Pillow Design】To provide a more comfortable resting environment for your dog, we have added a circle of U-shaped pillows around the outdoor dog beds, which can provide excellent neck and head support, allowing your dog to find the best sleeping position, promote body relaxation, and provide better sleep quality. The outdoor dog bed pillow can be cleaned and disassembled.

【Safe and Stable, Easy to Assemble】This dog cot features a powder-coated steel frame, durable 600D Oxford cloth, and non-slip rubber feet, providing excellent stability and high load-bearing capacity to ensure pet safety. The cooling bed for dogs is easy to install and requires no tools. It can be assembled with a simple insertion.
